text:
Introduction
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes ... etc
Ensure that the 
 disconnect switch is isolated and earthed on both sides.
Change remote / local control switch to local position
Tools and Equipment
Multimeter, blower gas detector, buzzer, screw driver and set of common
 keys
Works to be Carried Out
Perform the annual inspection steps as MPIS doc no. DS-024-r0
Check the alarms and adjust if needed (3.2 bar & 3 bar)
Measure and record dewpoint.
Check interlocking system.
Check contacts and replace if needed after 500 operating cycles
